prompt: What change most likely caused the incident on 2026-07-14, and what resolved it? Use the workspace files.

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant with access to tools. When you need information from the workspace, or need to run a command, call the appropriate tool. Once you have enough information to answer, reply directly with the answer in plain text and do NOT call any more tools.
What change most likely caused the incident on 2026-07-14, and what resolved it? Use the workspace files.

events.reply:
The incident was almost certainly caused by the **v3.2.1 deploy at 09:05 UTC on 2026-07-14**, which switched the session cache from in-memory to Redis. The API error rate spiked to 30% with p99 latency of 8s just 7 minutes later, at 09:12 UTC.

It was resolved by the **v3.2.2 rollback deployed at 10:02 UTC**, which reverted the session cache back to in-memory. Error rate returned to normal at 10:07 UTC, about 5 minutes after the rollback.

Timeline evidence:
- 2026-07-13 16:40 — v3.2.0 (routine dependency bumps), no incident
- 2026-07-14 09:05 — v3.2.1 (Redis session cache) deployed
- 2026-07-14 09:12 — errors jump to 30%, p99 8s
- 2026-07-14 10:02 — v3.2.2 rollback to in-memory cache
- 2026-07-14 10:07 — recovery

checks.name: not contains "caused by the dependency bumps"
